ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The network shown in the image has impedances in p.u. as indicated. The diagonal element \( Y_{22} \) of the bus admittance matrix \( Y_{\text{BUS}} \) of the network is ________
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure is a three-bus network, with bus 1, bus 2, and bus 3 connected horizontally in sequence. The series branch between bus 1 and bus 2 is labeled +j0.1; the series branch between bus 2 and bus 3 is also labeled +j0.1. Bus 2 also has a shunt branch directly grounded, labeled -j20.0. Then reason: according to the definition of the diagonal element of the bus admittance matrix, Y22 is equal to the sum of the admittances of all branches directly connected to bus 2. Take z12=j0.1, then y12=1/z12=1/(j0.1)=-j10. Take z23=j0.1, then y23=1/z23=-j10. The grounding branch of bus 2 is z2g=-j20.0, then y2g=1/z2g=1/(-j20.0)=+j0.05. Therefore Y22=y12+y23+y2g=-j10-j10+j0.05=-j19.95.
